THE STATE AGRICULTURAL CORPORATIONS ACT, NO.11 OF 1972Order under Section 2

I, Gardihewa Sarath Chandralal Fonseka, Minister of Regional Development do by this Order with the concurrence of the Minister to whomthe subject of Finance is assigned and the Minister to whom the subject of National Policies is assigned, amend the Order made by me underSection 2 of the State Agricultural Corporations Act, No. 11 of 1972 and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 302/12 of February 1,1978 as follows:-
1. By the repeal of paragraph (5) and the substitution therefore of the following:-"(5) state that the principal place of business of the Authority shall be Colombo;"
2. By the repeal of paragraphs (7) and (8).
3. By the substitution for the words "FIRST SCHEDULE" of the word "Schedule";

4. In item (1) of the Schedule, by the substitution for the words " government or non- government agencies in such areas that maybe specified by the Minister, from time to time;" of the words "government or non-government agencies;";
5. In item (5) of the Schedule, by the substitution for the words and figure "specified in paragraph (1)." of the words and figure"specified in paragraph (1);"
6. Immediately after item (5) of the Schedule, by the insertion of the following new items:-
"(6) to encourage, promote and assist both local and foreign agro -industry investments in commercial farming or any otheragricultural enterprise;

(7)to formulate and execute plans, deliver services and provide expertise to establish and manage such agro-industryinvestments undertaken by non-government agencies, private sector of farmers either in partnership with theAuthority or without the Authority.".
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

7. By the repeal of the SECOND SCHEDULE without prejudice to anything done thereunder.

8. In this Order-(a) "agro - industry" means any enterprise or institution delivering material inputs to the farming sector and transforming, distributing or otherwise adding value to agricultural raw material targeting both local and international market demands;
(b) "Commercial farming" includes crop farming, livestock farming and horticulture, floriculture and sericulturetargeting the market demands; and

(c) "other agricultural enterprises" includes tissue culture, manufacturing of organic fertilizer, processing of food andedible oil, pharmaceutical manufacturing using medicinal crops, agro tourism, manufacturing of agricultural machinery and other ancillary equipment and such other industries based on agriculture, horiculture and plantation crops.
Field Marshal GARDIHEWA SARATH CHANDRALAL FONSEKA,Minister of Regional Development.
